Definition: ado, i.e. (generally) employment or (specifically) an affair
BiblicalUsage: A task is the work God gives a man to do, and the Preacher weighs it and finds it heavy. In Ecclesiastes 1:13 he gives his heart to seek out the sore travail God has given to the sons of men, in Ecclesiastes 2:23 all his days are sorrows and his travail grief, in Ecclesiastes 3:10 he sees the travail God has given to be exercised in it, and in Ecclesiastes 5:14 those riches perish by evil travail.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the Preacher is honest about work in a way I need: the task God gives is real and heavy. Only God can make it light.
